title: Validate and sort team codes
description: Implement organise(codes). A valid code is exactly two uppercase ASCII letters followed by 1–2 ASCII digits, representing 1–99 with no leading zero. Discard invalid codes, preserve duplicates, and use insertion sort by (number, two-letter prefix). Return [even_codes, odd_codes], each in that order.
hints: Validate before converting; sort by a pair of keys.
